Botanica Four Seasons

Villa in Pru Jampa
HomeNew ProjectsBotanica Four Seasons

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

A large low-density villa community of single-storey pool homes in the Pru Jampa area of Thalang, split into Spring, Summer, Autumn and Winter zones with Modern Zen, Modern Loft and Tropical Balinese styles. The masterplan covers over 231,000 sqm and has a central Seasons Change clubhouse. Foreign buyers hold the land via leasehold.

Facilities & amenities

  • Seasons Change Clubhouse
  • Fitness center
  • Co-working space
  • Cafe and lounge
  • Tennis court and mini golf
  • Jogging and walking paths
  • Children's playground
  • 24/7 security
  • Landscaped gardens
